title: Ugukurikirana kw'Ingoro
intro: Mu bibanza vy’ubutegetsi, umuntu w’icubahiro kinini yarakundanye n’umusuku ubwiza bwiwe bwari ubw’ahandi. Ukwo gukundana kwatumye haba urutonde rw’ibintu vyogerageza ubudahemuka, bihishura ukuri kwihishije, maze amaherezo bikemeza ko uwo musuku ata caha afise.
clues: Nabaye mu gihugu c’uruzi Nili, mu kirimba c’ububasha bwinshi.
Hari umusore yaje mu rugo rwanje, ukuhaba kwiwe kwatumye isi yanje ihungabana.
Nagerageje kumuhendahenda, ariko arondera ubuhungiro mu Mukama wiwe.
Narataburuye impuzu yiwe inyuma, ariko ibimenyamenya vyerekana ko nari ndiko ndahenda.
Kugira ngo ncereze urusaku rw’abo bagore b’abanyacubahiro, narabatumiye mu nama, nkabashira mu minwe ibintu bisongoye.
Amaherezo, naratura ikosa ryanje ku mugaragaro, nemera ukuri imbere y’umwami.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yarubatse umunara kugira ngo arwanye Allah

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
